summary: Review of 7.8 chunk 1 (34 units). Issues: 29 minor, 24 error; 53 machine patches. No regrouping suggested. Main points: glossary 7.2 renderings (pravāsa, pratyavāya, mūla-hara) not followed in units 2, 7, 18, 21; karma = action and 'burden' invented sense in unit 5; sāmavāyika = associate (7.4/7.9); yātavya Hindi per glossary 7.5, jyāyas = the superior (7.5), paṇ and bhūyaḥ per 7.7; unit 28 stray 'or' in a dvandva and misplaced अथवा; unit 31 invented 'slip away'; unit 34 vikrama Hindi and closing 'ity' line. Unit 27 reading of 'tam' (may agree with artham) stays low confidence. Hand edits: unit 27 text_flag suggest should read 'taṃ ca-artham' (vā deleted) instead of prose. Note for the caller: Book 7 ch06 renders sandhi 'treaty' while 7.2/7.8 and Books 8-9 use 'peace'; ch04/ch05 yātavya Hindi differs from ch07.
